vulnerabilities.title: Denial of Service (DoS)
vulnerabilities.description:
## Overview
[github.com/buger/jsonparser](https://github.com/buger/jsonparser) is an Alternative JSON parser for Go.

Affected versions of this package are vulnerable to Denial of Service (DoS) via a `GET` call.

## Details

Denial of Service (DoS) describes a family of attacks, all aimed at making a system inaccessible to its intended and legitimate users.

Unlike other vulnerabilities, DoS attacks usually do not aim at breaching security. Rather, they are focused on making websites and services unavailable to genuine users resulting in downtime.

One popular Denial of Service vulnerability is DDoS (a Distributed Denial of Service), an attack that attempts to clog network pipes to the system by generating a large volume of traffic from many machines.

When it comes to open source libraries, DoS vulnerabilities allow attackers to trigger such a crash or crippling of the service by using a flaw either in the application code or from the use of open source libraries.

Two common types of DoS vulnerabilities:

* High CPU/Memory Consumption- An attacker sending crafted requests that could cause the system to take a disproportionate amount of time to process. For example, [commons-fileupload:commons-fileupload](https://security.snyk.io/vuln/SNYK-JAVA-COMMONSFILEUPLOAD-30082).

* Crash - An attacker sending crafted requests that could cause the system to crash. For Example,  [npm `ws` package](https://snyk.io/vuln/npm:ws:20171108)

## Remediation
Upgrade `github.com/buger/jsonparser` to version 1.1.1 or higher.
## References
- [GitHub Issue](https://github.com/buger/jsonparser/issues/219)
- [GitHub PR](https://github.com/buger/jsonparser/pull/221)

## Details

Two common types of DoS vulnerabilities:

* High CPU/Memory Consumption- An attacker sending crafted requests that could cause the system to take a disproportionate amount of time to process. For example, [commons-fileupload:commons-fileupload](https://security.snyk.io/vuln/SNYK-JAVA-COMMONSFILEUPLOAD-30082).

vulnerabilities.title: Uncaught Exception
vulnerabilities.description:
## Overview
[github.com/buger/jsonparser](https://github.com/buger/jsonparser) is an Alternative JSON parser for Go.

Affected versions of this package are vulnerable to Uncaught Exception via the `Delete` function when processing malformed JSON input. An attacker can cause a runtime panic and disrupt service availability by submitting specially crafted JSON data that triggers improper offset validation.
## Remediation
Upgrade `github.com/buger/jsonparser` to version 1.1.2 or higher.
## References
- [GitHub Commit](https://github.com/buger/jsonparser/commit/d3eacc0bab779d6cf98221f5268828fff287876e)
- [GitHub Issue](https://github.com/buger/jsonparser/issues/275)
- [GitHub Issue](https://github.com/golang/vulndb/issues/4514)
- [Go Advisory](https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-4514)
- [Vulnerability Research](https://securityinfinity.com/research/buger-jsonparser-negative-slice-panic-dos-2026)
- [Vulnerable Code](https://github.com/buger/jsonparser/blob/61b32cfdfa0f5d368ef7c7daef28ce12d538740f/parser.go#L748-L757)
